text:
emily: Quick follow-up from today's runtime roadmap segment. Need 3 short clarifications we can paste into notes: 1) sprint windows for sparse-attn vs quant kernels; 2) Hosted KV eviction default; 3) recommended conservative batching defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated (batch_ms, max_batch_tokens, prewarm). Keep replies one line each. @sam @raj @kevin
sam: Sparse-attn: in this sprint but feature-gated (canary pending); Quant kernels: planning this week, landing sprint+1.
raj: Hosted KV eviction: LRU by default; weighted-LRU experimental opt-in.
kevin: Ops note: p99 spikes mostly from cold-starts and oversized requests; added trace flag `cold_start` and will abort canary if kernel_error_rate >1% in first 15m.
dina: Can infra drop a copy-ready YAML snippet we can paste into docs? PM wants a ready block.
lisa: I'll produce a small CSV (p50/p95/p99 + rough cost delta) across batch_ms buckets (5/10/15/25) and attach to DOC ticket. ETA Wed AM.
sam: Paste-ready conservative defaults for docs: 
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 12
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    adaptive: true
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    ttl_seconds: 0
  prewarm:
    enabled: false
    window_ms: 1000
  canary_guardrails:
    initial_traffic_pct: 5
    error_rate_abort_pct: 1.0
```

maria: PM ask: please include a short cost-delta column in the CSV (even rough percentages) so sales has talking points.
raj: Dedicated guidance: with prewarm enabled, batch_ms=20-25 and max_batch_tokens=8192 gives best unit-cost for steady traffic; I'll draft sizing rules after Lisa's CSV.
canary-bot: canary-plan: kernel-v11 scheduled canary window 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-10T04:00:00Z. Gating: CI perf green + smoke tests.
emily: Can someone post a two-line summary for the all-hands notes with owners+ETA? One sentence per item.
sam: I'll post a 2-line summary by EOD: "Sparse-attn: this sprint (gate pending) -> canary next week; Quantized kernels: sprint+1 planning; KV default: LRU; Batching defaults: Hosted batch_ms=12/max_tokens=4096, Dedicated w/prewarm batch_ms=20-25/max_tokens=8192. Owners: Sam/Raj/Lisa. ETAs: Sam EOD, Lisa Wed, Raj Thu."
dina: Filed DOC-9902 to track docs + CSV. Owner: Dina.
kevin: I'll validate CI perf suite and ensure the abort rule is wired into the canary pipeline.
emily: Thanks all 44d I'll publish notes once Sam posts the 2-line summary. If you want to opt out of follow-ups, say so here.
